utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m making sure Pia has the details for Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center, and I’m still spreading the word. Vik’s on it, and Nell’s getting the details too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll join late and help fill whatever gap is left. Keep me posted if there’s a small part you want me to take on.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep you posted. If you can take on a small gap, I’ll send it your way.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that gives us a solid start. I’ll bring the drop-off list and keep my Saturday morning open until Oren updates us.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the final time and place too, but I’ll pass along anything I hear as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds right, Nell. I’ll stay ready for Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center and keep my schedule open until we hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, that helps — 3 works for me, and I’m glad Jules is lining it up around the school schedule. Please keep me posted on the times so I can work around pickups.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still not locked in yet, right? Let me know as soon as Rosa confirms the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Right, still waiting on Rosa to confirm the time and place. Thanks — please send it over as soon as you hear.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center — I may have missed a detail or two, so it’s good Vik is helping organize it and spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Actually, it’s Saturday afternoon at the community hall, and we’re focusing on broken household items and small furniture. We still need a couple more screwdrivers and a few extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh — thanks for catching that. Saturday afternoon at the community hall, and we still need a couple screwdrivers and extra hands, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’ll be there a little early to sort out parking. It’s this Saturday afternoon at the community hall, right?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s Saturday at 10 at the community center — I’ll make sure everyone knows and see what still needs filling. I’ll check in with Uli and Cleo, too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh—thanks for checking, but I have it down for Saturday afternoon at the community hall. I’ll still come early for parking, and we may want to confirm the time and place with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Bo’s place is first on the route, and the repair drive is this Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center. It’s really coming together nicely, with folks pitching in tools and parts.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — I’ll double-check that 10 a.m. start time and let Mina know. Do we still need any volunteers, or is the list full now?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll keep an eye out this afternoon for any updates on volunteers or missing tools, and I’ll pass them along if I hear anything. Right now it sounds like it’s shaping up nicely, but I’ll let you know if anything still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can help if you still need volunteers. I’m also checking on spare screws and a flashlight for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be great, Mina — the repair drive is still this afternoon, and the drop-off table should help folks see what still needs fixing. I’m still sorting the final plan, but I’ll pass along any new details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren. Just let me know if you still need volunteers, and I’ll bring the spare screws and flashlight if I can.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center, and my place is the first stop. I’ll skim the details and flag anything off.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Bo — just a quick correction: the repair drive is this Saturday afternoon at the community hall. We’re collecting broken household items and small furniture, and Gus should be there around 3 with extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks — I’ll flag that change and check the details. Saturday afternoon at the community hall, got it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Right, the first stop is Bo’s place, and then I’m headed to the community center parking lot tomorrow morning. Rosa’s got the details going to Bo for review too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — once the time and place are locked in, I’ll send the repair drive details out. Then I’ll check in with the folks who asked for help, plus the hardware store and community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — the parking lot at the community center tomorrow morning is the key spot, and Bo’s place is still first on the list. Once you send it out, I’ll keep track of who’s where.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Still waiting on your confirmation for the time and place. I’ll stop by around 3 and can pass along any updates then.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s set for Sunday at the community center, and Bo’s place is still our first stop. I’ll send Bo the details to review, and thanks for stopping by around 3 with any updates.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, that works. I’ll stop by around 3 and let folks know Sunday at the community center, with Bo’s place first.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s set for Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep it small and straightforward, and I’ll let Nell know right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks — just a quick note, it’s still on for Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center. If you or Cleo can jump in, we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m sorry, but Rosa confirmed Sunday at the community center. I’ll stick with that and let Nell know right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m heading out to run a few errands and ask around for updates. I should be back home around 3, and Jules said they’ll keep Leo in the loop if the timing gets confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll be there around 3 with my tool bag and a few extra tools, and I can help sort donations too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, I’ll be back around 3 too, so that should line up. I’ll keep an ear out for Jules’ update while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll be there around 3 with my tool bag and a few extra tools. I’m also happy to help sort the donations at the hall this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — the repair drive is Saturday at 10 at the community center, and I’ll spread the word so everyone knows to pitch in. I’ll also help sort out who needs what, and your tools will be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Vik — that sounds great. I’ll bring the tool bag around 3 and help sort donations at the hall on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center still works for me. I’ll bring duct tape and a screwdriver and help out where I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — I have the repair drive down as this Saturday afternoon at the community hall, not 10 a.m. at the center. I’ll check whether we still need volunteers before I confirm anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh—thanks for checking. I’m still able to help, and I’ll bring the duct tape and a screwdriver once you confirm the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Still set for this afternoon; I’m waiting on Rosa to confirm the exact time and place. I’ll stop by around 3 and pass along any updates.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — it’s at the community hall this Saturday afternoon, and Gus said he’s coming around 3 with a tool bag. I’ll keep an eye out for Rosa’s update too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, that helps — I’ll plan on the community hall Saturday afternoon and check in around 3. If Rosa confirms anything sooner, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll be there Saturday at 10 at the community center, and I’m happy to help with sorting donations and basic repairs. If you hear anything else about parking or the plan, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll swing by a bit late and take whatever small gap needs filling. Keep me posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anything shifts. See you Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s lined up around the school schedule, and the first stop is Bo’s place. Once I’ve got the time and place set, I’ll send the details along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still not actually set yet, right? Just let me know once Rosa locks down the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, still getting the time and place locked in. I’ll let you know as soon as Rosa confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—send me the details and I’ll flag anything that looks off. My place is still the first stop, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, your place is still the first stop, and Rosa’s sending the details for you to review. Then it’s the community center parking lot tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—I'll check it over and flag anything off. Thanks for confirming the first stop.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Quinn’s got the word out, and the repair drive is looking really solid. It’s this Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center, with Bo’s place as the first stop.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great — I’m glad Quinn got the word out. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates from Jules on the timing, too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s perfect — I’ll keep you posted if anything shifts, and Eli’s bringing a clear drop-off list too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can bring spare screws and a flashlight, and I’m still available to help if you need another volunteer. Do you know if the repair drive still needs people?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m headed out to run errands and ask around for updates. If anything gets confirmed, have Oren or Vik let me know—I should be back home around 3.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — I’ll wait to hear back from Oren or Vik, then.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep — Pia’s invited, and the repair drive is this Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center. I’m making sure everyone has the details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, great — thanks, Quinn. I’ll pass that along to Eli and Ira, and I’ll keep an ear out if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks, Oren — that helps a lot. If you hear anything new, just let me know so I can keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Uli — I’m sending Bo the repair drive details next so they can review everything. We’re still set for Sunday at the community center, with Bo’s place as the first stop.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good, Rosa. I’ll let Nell know right away that it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — I appreciate you looping Nell in. That’ll help keep everyone on the same page for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli — 3 still works for me, and I’m just waiting on the repair drive time so I can work around school pickups.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center still stands. I’ll keep my schedule open and bring the drop-off list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it — 10 a.m. on Saturday works, and I’ll plan around school pickups. Thanks for keeping your schedule open and bringing the drop-off list.
